purpose: Reads and writes the notes a person keeps about someone in their own vault, private or shared with that person, one claim per note.
namedChanges: The imports are the units' `lws-vault-sets` (`pageAllByAttribute`, `registerCardPartTypes`), `resource-id` (`idFromResourceUri`), `stated-by` (`isStatedBy`), `vault-origin-rule` (`vaultOriginOf`), `vault-resources` (`createResource`, `deleteResource`, `getResource`, `patchResource`, `readResources`, `FactValue`, `ReadResource`), `lws-records` (`patchRecord`, `readRecord`, `MergePatchValue`, `WriteSource`), `term-slots` (`attributeSpelling`, `typeSpelling`) and `adder-card` (`useAdderCard`).
`DIRECT_READER` (`"a:directReader"`) is a named copy in `src/directReader.ts`, exported: the place-claim module of the app, where it is defined, is in no unit yet and will import it from here.

Comments that name a cycle, a ticket, an agent, a person, a ruling or a test run are reworded with the same facts; no code changed. The comment-stripped files, imports excluded, equal the source (`heldNote.ts` 1261 words, `useHeldNotes.ts` 1479, `heldDetailMark.ts` 341, `heldNoteVocab.ts` 263; 0 diff lines each).
Every symbol the source exports is exported from the entry point; nothing is added to the source's own exports (`hostOf`, `MARKS`, `chains`, the vocabulary caches stay private).
